summary: First testing iteration after full frontend rebuild. Backend (multi-tenant POS) is solid: 23/23 pytest after 1 test correction. Frontend critical flows all work end-to-end (login, products CRUD, POS add-to-cart, checkout with cash + change, orders list, stats, cashiers, cash register, settings, logout, PWA manifest). One CRITICAL issue: the 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps and intercepts clicks on the desktop POS 'Cobrar' (cart-checkout-button) at viewport 1280x800 because the button sits at bottom-right of the cart sidebar where the badge is fixed. Real users on desktop will not be able to click checkout.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased server-side. Returned email differs from submitted casing. Documented behavior, but consider noting in API docs.

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed 'Made with Emergent' badge (id=emergent-badge, position:fixed bottom:16px right:16px) intercepts pointer events on the [data-testid=cart-checkout-button] (Cobrar button) at viewport widths around 1280px. Playwright confirmed: 'a#emergent-badge intercepts pointer events'. After removing the badge from DOM, the click works and the checkout modal opens normally. Move the Cobrar button up (add bottom padding/margin), or relocate the badge, or add z-index/pointer-events tuning so the cart action area is not covered.

design_issues.screen: Dialogs (product options, checkout, mobile cart, product form)
issues: React/Radix console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' on every Dialog. Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for accessibility (and to remove warnings).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the desktop 'Cobrar' button being blocked by the Emergent badge. Suggested fix: in CartContent footer, add `pb-20` / increase bottom padding so the Cobrar button is not in the bottom-right 178x40 region; OR wrap the cart sidebar footer with extra spacing; OR raise its z-index above #emergent-badge if appropriate.
Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to all DialogContent components in POSPage.jsx and ProductsPage.jsx to silence React Radix accessibility warning.
Optional: In /api/auth/restaurant/register response, document that emails are normalized to lowercase.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes datetime.utcnow() (Order, Product) and datetime.now(timezone.utc) (Restaurant). Standardize on timezone-aware UTC to avoid future mismatches.
server.py is 850 lines – consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/products.py, routers/orders.py, etc. for maintainability.

Password reset uses only first-8-chars-of-token comparison (case-insensitive). This reduces security to ~36 bits worst-case (alphanumeric uppercase). Acceptable for now since secrets.token_urlsafe is used, but consider using full token in URL link instead.
Legacy /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register (manager User) endpoints still exist alongside multi-tenant ones – dead code, should be removed to avoid confusion.
AuthContext.checkAuth catches all errors silently and clears storage; consider distinguishing 401 vs network errors.

Frontend CartContent is mounted both inside desktop sidebar and inside a Dialog (mobile drawer); when both are mounted there are duplicate data-testids. Currently mobile drawer only mounts when open so it's fine, but worth a comment.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py – run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. All 23 backend tests pass. The CRITICAL frontend issue (Emergent badge blocking Cobrar) needs to be retested at viewport 1280x800 after main agent's fix; verify by removing Playwright's force=True on cart-checkout-button click. Demo account exists; today's orders for demo restaurant should be cleaned up if they interfere with tests.
rca of the issue: The 'Made with Emergent' badge in /app/frontend/public/index.html is fixed-positioned at bottom:16px right:16px with width 178px height 40px and z-index 9999. The desktop cart sidebar in POSPage.jsx renders the 'Cobrar' button (data-testid=cart-checkout-button) at the bottom of a 384px wide sidebar (lg:w-96) – i.e. its lower-right corner sits inside the badge's hit area at viewport 1280x800. Playwright reports: '<a id="emergent-badge"> intercepts pointer events' when attempting to click the button without force. This blocks real user clicks. Reproduction: open https://<host>/login at viewport 1280x800 → login → add a product to cart → click 'Cobrar'. Mitigation: add bottom padding to the cart footer (e.g. `pb-24 md:pb-6`) so the button moves above the badge, OR raise the cart sidebar's z-index for that button area, OR avoid the badge overlay (cannot remove badge).
